description: Assistant eval cases. Each case runs the real chat loop, tool registry, services and permission evaluator over the seeded harness world (tests/eval/harness.ts). Assertions are about tool calls, tool payloads and facts, never prose. `{cashCheckId}`-style placeholders in `input` are replaced by the harness with the ids of the seeded spreadsheet checks. `mocked` cases run with the scripted provider in vitest; `live` runs need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (scripts/assistant-eval.ts).
